assessment: The authors present how unsaturated fatty acids modulate the bactericidal effect of the antibiotic vancomycin. The authors find that palmitoleic acid significantly increases the bactericidal activity of vancomycin and reveal the mechanism responsible. The key findings will be of interest to a broad audience of researchers focused on microbiology, host-pathogen interactions, and antimicrobial development, as well as to clinicians that treat antibiotic-recalcitrant infections.
